name: Landbright · Hand over a leaver's agents
description: On identity.deactivated from the Landbright Trigger, when agents were suspended with the person (they sponsored them): email the person's manager that those agents wait for a new sponsor (a Landbright administrator gives them one and resumes them, in Agents). An agent needs an accountable person; until someone takes it over it stays suspended. Needs the landbright plugin.
